definition: to tell something to everyone present
description: On a rooftop terrace above a city at sunset, under string lights, a young woman with long dark hair in a green satin dress raises her left hand high to show off an engagement ring and laughs. Her friend in a yellow dress claps, then throws her arms around her and cheers. A young man in a light blue shirt and cream trousers punches both fists into the air and jumps with joy. On a small wooden table stand glasses of lemonade and a vase of red roses, with folding chairs and city buildings around them.

to punch the air with joy
